market_wide_observations: July was primarily driven by corporate earnings.
FPI buying returned selectively during the month.
Consumer services, metals and healthcare attracted notable FPI interest.
Banking, realty and auto remained important market drivers.
IT remained the weakest major sectoral theme.
AI infrastructure became a cross-sector investment theme.
Semiconductor localization created opportunities beyond chip manufacturers.
High crude prices remained the largest macro risk.
Geopolitical developments continued influencing global risk appetite.
